native_policy.controls: Human kernel tests native RT (0x10) for acceleration, LT (0x20) for braking and newly pressed A (0x00040000 in packed input) for boost. A alone is not an accelerator.
native_policy.physics_cadence: FFF0FC02 waits for WRAM118A >= 3, then clears it; one mechanics update per three display fields
native_policy.finish: Initial start crossing clears +50 without incrementing +48. Five subsequent complete circuits advance +48 from0 to5. Versus records a finish at that crossing field, before same-field crash: this immediate result ordering is the graft policy, not a claim about stock finish-handler timing.
native_policy.crash: Native damage +38 reaches 800; finish is checked before crash in a shared update
native_policy.contact: The stock two-body response identifies the human through global10FC/model identity. The versus pair view normalizes this classification for both humans, retains each raw handling profile and restores chosen render identities.
native_policy.initialization: Native setup clears +58 for its selected human and allocates +64 to CPUs. Every versus racer receives the human form.
native_policy.pair_order: Each unordered pair once, in ascending slot order; new versus simulation profile
native_policy.link: No usable link protocol has been established. The communication IRQ vector contains a thunk; its presence is not evidence of multiplayer implementation or absence.
native_policy.warning: 18C18 calculates the native power-world/blink and roll bias0/+80/-80 from damage and1048 phase. F6D6 temporarily adds114C at model+20, then restores it atF758. Each view owns its copied model and next-update latch; actor physics/shared world never receive this angle. Native172B0 also advances the primary1168 damage-message latch.
